svg.title: Running total with SUM() OVER
svg.desc: The 8 flights are partitioned by carrier and sorted by dep_time. SUM(dep_delay) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY dep_time) adds each row's delay to the total of the rows before it in the same partition. AA: f4 20, then f7 20 + (-8) = 12. DL: f2 5, then f6 5 + 30 = 35. UA: f1 12, f3 12 + (-3) = 9, f5 9 + 7 = 16, f8 16 + 15 = 31. The total resets at the start of each partition, and all 8 rows remain.
svg.text: Running total: SUM() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)
Each row adds its own dep_delay to the total of the rows before it. The total resets in every partition.
ORDER BY inside OVER sets the running order.
With an ORDER BY, the default window frame runs
from the partition's first row to the current row,
so each total covers only the rows up to this one.
Drop PARTITION BY for one total across all flights.
